template.name: CCI MA v1.5
template.notes: CCI has no DSL function, so it is proxied by zscore(close,20): crossing its own zero line equals the documented CCI/SMA cross, and the supervisory CCI's +100 exit maps to a +2 z-score drop as the same relative extremity. CciPeriod, MaPeriod and SignalCciPeriod have no documented values so 20 is an explicit default, and pip stops are not percentages.
